payload.posture: Read Ephesians 2:19–22 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states strangers become household and holy temple. So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the saints and of the household of God, in whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
